messages:
maya (Marketing PM): Quick sync — I want to run a quick page experiment for pricing next week. Goal: reduce contact form starts but capture higher quality leads. Plan: 1) add a 3-line micro-FAQ under tiers, 2) try alternative tier names that emphasize scale (e.g., 'Starter / Scale / Enterprise' vs 'Core / Pro / Enterprise'), 3) tweak the calculator to surface an "estimated monthly" and an ops-cost line. Thoughts?

sam (Growth): +1. Also route calculator leads differently: if estimate > $5k/mo route to sales; otherwise marketing nurture. We should add a hidden input for company size to improve routing. :thinking:

elena (Content): I can draft 3 micro-FAQ items. Suggested copy tone: straightforward, cost-first, trust signals. Example Qs: "How are tokens counted?", "Can I reserve capacity?", "What security controls are included?" Keep each answer 1 sentence.

jon (Design): I can do two visual variants for the tier names and calculator callout. Variant A highlights "Scale" with a small ribbon, Variant B uses numeric comparators (1–5k / 5–50k / 50k+). Will push frames to Figma by EOD. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-experiments

tess (Analytics): We should define primary metric: demo/contact conversion rate for traffic to /pricing plus quality signal (MQL flag). Secondary: calculator engagement (click-to-fill rate) and bounce on pricing. I'll wire GA events and set an experiment id.

maya (Marketing PM): Nice. Decision checklist: a) Tier name variants A/B, b) Micro-FAQ vs no-FAQ (control), c) Calculator UX with "estimated monthly" + ops-cost line vs current. We'll run 3x2 factorial? Sam, are you ok with funnel routing rule above?

sam (Growth): Yep. I'll add routing rules to the ingestion lambda. If estimate > 5000 OR company_size == "enterprise" mark as Sales route. We'll capture UTMs.

elena (Content): Drafts posted here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1PricingDrafts. I'll keep each FAQ answer <140 chars. Also propose a short testimonial line under tiers: "Reduced inference costs by 3x — GenDocs" (we need permission) — I can swap a generic guardrail if not approved.

jon (Design): Uploaded variants as frames: A = ribbon Scale, B = numeric bands. Calculator mock includes an 'ops overhead' slider. Quick note — moving micro-FAQ up pushes fold on smaller screens. Need to test mobile.

tess (Analytics): Experiment id created: PRC_184682. Will track: event_pricing_calc_open, event_pricing_calc_submit, event_pricing_contact_start, event_marketing_mql. I'll baseline numbers and post in the sheet.

maya (Marketing PM): Timeline: draft copy by tomorrow noon, design frames by EOD, analytics wired by tomorrow afternoon, QA Friday, rollout Mon morning to 25% traffic. Can everyone hit that?

sam (Growth): Yep. I'll also set a Slack alert when any calculator submission hits >10k estimate so AE can triage.

elena (Content): On it. I'll post the finalized micro-FAQ variants here for a quick copy review before EOD.

jon (Design): I'll add mobile-safe spacing options. If we need a compact mobile FAQ, suggest collapsible chevrons.

launch-bot: Experiment PRC_184682 created and scheduled — start: 1846907400, rollout: 25% -> 100% over 72h.

maya (Marketing PM): Awesome. Post links and I'll create a brief exec note for Monday (metrics to watch + risk areas). Thanks team! :rocket:
